task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the maximum difference between any two elements in a given array.
specification_response:
method MaxDifference(a: array<int>) returns (diff: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
- The value of diff is equal to the maximum difference between any two elements in the input array
- diff is greater than or equal to 0
- There exist indices i, j within the bounds of the array such that diff equals |a[j] - a[i]| and this difference is maximal among all pairs in the array
